title.original: A Declarative Language for Building And Orchestrating LLM-Powered Agent Workflows
title.zh: 用于构建与编排 LLM 智能体工作流的声明式语言
title.en: A Declarative Language for Building And Orchestrating LLM-Powered Agent Workflows

inclusion_reason.zh: 该 DSL、后端无关中间表示和多语言适配器使 Agent 工作流可跨部署复用、配置更新和 A/B 评测。
inclusion_reason.en: The DSL, backend-neutral IR, and multi-language adapters make agent workflows reusable across deployments and support configuration updates and A/B evaluation.

abstract.zh: 该系统以声明式 DSL 分离 Agent 工作流规范与 Java、Python、Go 等后端实现，使同一流水线可在云原生或本地环境执行。语言覆盖序列化、过滤、RAG、API 编排等常见模式，并原生支持多个策略变体的 A/B 评测。
abstract.en: This system separates agent workflow specification from Java, Python, and Go implementations through a declarative DSL, allowing one pipeline to run in cloud-native or on-premises environments. It covers serialization, filtering, RAG, and API orchestration and supports native A/B testing of strategy variants.

problem.zh: 部署级 Agent 将工具、数据与控制流紧耦合到语言和部署模型，任何行为调整都可能需要重新编码与发布，阻碍跨环境复用和安全实验。
problem.en: Deployment-ready agents tightly couple tools, data, and control flow to a language and deployment model, forcing code changes and releases for behavior tuning and hindering portability and controlled experimentation.

approach.zh: DSL 把常见 Agent 步骤、数据边和分支表达为配置，编译/运行层将规范映射到不同语言后端；策略变体共享基础设施并自动收集比较指标。
approach.en: The DSL expresses common agent steps, data edges, and branches as configuration, which compilation and runtime layers map to different language backends; variants share infrastructure and collect comparison metrics automatically.

system_design.zh: 系统包含 DSL schema、后端无关的工作流中间表示、Java/Python/Go 执行适配器和实验遥测层；工具或行为可通过规范更新而非应用重新部署。
system_design.en: The stack comprises a DSL schema, backend-neutral workflow representation, Java/Python/Go execution adapters, and experiment telemetry, so tools and behavior can change through specification updates rather than application redeployment.

key_results.zh: 在 PayPal 每日数百万交互的电商流程中，作者报告开发时间缩短、部署迭代更快，并以远少于命令式实现的 DSL 行数表达复杂流程。
key_results.en: In PayPal e-commerce workflows processing millions of daily interactions, the authors report shorter development time, faster deployment iteration, and far more compact specifications than imperative implementations.

limitations.zh: 声明式表达能力受预置模式和适配器限制，复杂动态控制仍可能回落到代码；证据主要来自单一企业场景，跨组织治理与调试体验未量化。
limitations.en: Declarative expressiveness is bounded by available patterns and adapters, with highly dynamic control likely falling back to code; evidence is centered on one enterprise, and cross-organization governance and debugging are not quantified.

metrics.name: workflow specification size
metrics.value: under 50 DSL lines vs 500+ imperative lines

notes.zh: PayPal 场景、日交互规模、命令式基线和四项结果来自官方摘要；后端配置、模型、统计方法和分场景结果待全文审计。
notes.en: PayPal scenarios, daily scale, imperative baseline, and four results come from the official abstract; backends, models, statistics, and per-scenario results await full-text audit.
